notes:
Build anywhere: a "base" is wherever your structures happen to be.

`solid` blocks feet but never bullets (invariant 3) — a base you cannot shoot out of is a base that punishes you for building it. `protect` marks the pieces a raider inside the perimeter should prefer, so a horde that is already through heads for the workbench rather than back out. `threat` scales what putting one up costs you in attention. `store` is a slot count; `tier` 2 needs the upgraded workbench.

rows.desc: Sets your respawn point. Only the newest one is active.
rows.name: Bedroll

rows.desc: Somewhere for one survivor to sleep. No bunk, no recruit.
rows.name: Bunk

rows.desc: A seed, some water and a few days. Grows food to cook or eat.
rows.name: Raised Bed
rows.notes: Not solid — you walk through your own garden — and deliberately **not** `protect`. A vegetable patch is not a fortification: marking it would widen `BASE.radius` around the allotment and make a raid walk at the lettuce, and neither of those is what a bed is for.

rows.desc: Assign a survivor here and they cover the whole approach.
rows.name: Watchtower

rows.desc: The base pantry and armoury. 48 slots. Survivors and towers feed from this one.
rows.name: Supply Stash
rows.notes: Its `store` is the shared stash's slot count: Config.STASH_SLOTS reads it from here, so this is the one number.

rows.desc: Sixteen slots of overflow. Cheap — build as many as you need.
rows.name: Wooden Chest

rows.desc: Thirty-two slots, and it survives a raid that flattens a chest.
rows.name: Steel Locker

rows.desc: Unlocks crafting while you stand near it. Upgradeable.
rows.name: Workbench

rows.desc: Cheap, fast, and flimsy. Good for funnelling.
rows.name: Barricade

rows.desc: Dry stone. No wood, no scrap — just what you carried up the hill.
rows.name: Stone Wall
rows.notes: Built from nothing but what the ground gives up: the wall you can raise before you own a single tool that needs metal.

rows.desc: Wood and sheet metal. Buys you real time.
rows.name: Reinforced Wall

rows.desc: Stand next to it and interact to open or close.
rows.name: Gate

rows.desc: Shreds anything that walks over it. Wears out.
rows.name: Spike Trap

rows.desc: Needs a powered Generator within 260px. Eats 9mm from your stash.
rows.name: Auto Turret

rows.desc: Pushes back the dark. Needs a powered Generator within 260px.
rows.name: Floodlight

rows.desc: Refines brain matter into something that does not fight back. Stand near it to craft.
rows.name: Chemistry Station
rows.notes: The only bench that is not a step up the workbench ladder. Chemistry is different work, not harder metalwork — folding it into `bench` would have made Workbench II hand out the suppressants for free, and the suppressant chain is the spine of the whole theme.

rows.desc: Burns Fuel to power turrets nearby. Loud — raises Threat while running.
rows.name: Generator
